items.name: Datadog
items.headline: Reports Q3 revenue growth of 35% and issues full-year revenue guidance
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue $1,197.1M vs $885.7M; GAAP diluted EPS $0.32 vs $0.10.
items.thesis: Full-year 2026 revenue is guided to $4.515-$4.525 billion and Q4 to $1.19-$1.20 billion. About 4,860 customers have ARR of $100,000 or more, up from about 4,060 a year ago.

items.name: Martin Marietta
items.headline: Reports record quarterly revenue and updates 2026 guidance after LNA combination
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues $2,369M vs $1,846M; adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations $808M vs $667M.
items.thesis: The company cited acquisition performance partly offset by softer heritage demand and inflationary cost pressures. Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $3.94 versus $5.97.

items.name: Royalty Pharma
items.headline: Raises 2026 Portfolio Receipts guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 Portfolio Receipts $890M vs $814M; guidance raised to $3,500-$3,550M from $3,400-$3,500M.
items.thesis: The company also recorded a $150 million non-cash impairment tied to pelacarsen after a Phase 3 trial missed its primary endpoint.

items.name: Vishay Intertechnology
items.headline: Reports highest quarterly revenue in its history with higher gross margin
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues $978.9M vs $790.6M; gross margin 25.5% vs 19.5%; diluted EPS $0.37 vs $(0.06).
items.thesis: Book-to-bill was 1.29 and backlog was 6.6 months. Q4 revenue is guided to $990 million plus or minus $15 million.

items.name: Cenovus Energy
items.headline: Reports Q3 results with highest-ever quarterly upstream production
items.catalyst: Adjusted funds flow $5,023M vs $2,466M; net earnings $3,360M vs $1,286M.
items.thesis: Upstream production was 1,023.5 MBOE/d and net debt was $2,999 million. The company returned $1.9 billion to shareholders in the quarter.
